# Task & Purpose

> Task & Purpose is a military news and analysis platform delivering breaking coverage of Pentagon operations, military technology, policy, and culture for active-duty service members, veterans, and defense-focused audiences.

Task & Purpose combines investigative military journalism with video analysis and community engagement, covering major conflicts including Iran operations and Ukraine, military equipment developments, personnel policy changes, and human-interest stories from the armed forces. The site maintains close sourcing relationships within the Pentagon, military branches, and veteran community.

## Key Topics

- Iran War
- Military Journalism
- Pentagon News
- Defense Technology
- Marine Corps
- Navy Operations
- Military Policy
- Veteran Community

- Defense Department

- Defense Analysis

## Breaking Military News

- [At least 200 US troops wounded in Iran War, Pentagon says](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/us-troops-iran-200-wounded): Pentagon reports 200+ US troops wounded in Operation Epic Fury Iran conflict
- [US orders more warships, thousands of Marines to the Middle East](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/marines-uss-boxer-middle-east): Boxer Amphibious Ready Group, 11th MEU deployment to Middle East conflict
- [US helicopters attacking Iranian militias in Iraq, top general says](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/military-apache-iraq-militias): AH-64D Apache operations against Iranian-backed militias in Iraq
- [USS Gerald R. Ford en route to Crete for repairs after fire](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/navy-uss-gerald-ford-repairs): USS Gerald R. Ford aircraft carrier traveling to Crete for fire damage repairs
- [Navy is keeping the USS Nimitz in service another year](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/navy-nimitz-extension): USS Nimitz service extension to March 2027 due to USS John F. Kennedy delays

## Military Technology & Equipment

- [The Army will soon field a new, smaller rifle, the XM8 carbine](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/army-next-generation-carbine): Army fielding XM8 carbine: lighter, shorter barrel than M7 rifle
- [Marines can use optic during pistol qualifications for first time](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/marines-optic-pistol-qualifications): Marine Corps allows M17 red dot optics for M18 pistol qualifications policy

## Military Life & Personnel

- [Air Force instructor faces court-martial for sleeping with students](https://taskandpurpose.com/military-life/air-force-instructor-court-martial-trainees): Staff Sgt. Davonte Hardaway court-martial for misconduct at Lackland AFB
- [Pentagon cracks down on issuing religious waivers for beards](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/military-beards-religious-waivers-2026): Pentagon reevaluates religious waivers for facial hair within 90 days
- [Army Reservist finally awarded Purple Heart after 10 years](https://taskandpurpose.com/military-life/purple-heart-afghanistan-reservist): Sgt. 1st Class Christina Larson receives Purple Heart 11 years after Afghanistan
- [Military families face moving delays due to Iran war](https://taskandpurpose.com/military-life/iran-war-pcs-impacts): Iran war shipping delays impact military family household goods PCS moves
- [Soldiers scramble to attend funeral of 'surrogate dad'](https://taskandpurpose.com/news/soldiers-scramble-to-attend-funeral): Iowa-based soldiers travel to memorial for Chief Warrant Officer Robert Marzan
